label: Max pull-ups
definition: The most overhand-grip, dead-hang pull-ups a person can do in one attempt without letting go of the bar, each rep starting from straight arms with the chin rising over the bar.
phrasings: how many pull ups can the top 1% of men do
how many pull ups is good for a man
average number of pull ups for men
how many pull ups can the average man do
how rare is it to do 15 pull ups
